statements.t: “We believe Q3 was an inflection point for Fold,” said Fold Chairman and CEO Will Reeves.

With our only debt extended two years, operating expenses down, and a financing partner for our Credit Card expected to be announced shortly, we believe Fold has never been better positioned for its next stage of growth.”

statements.t: By integrating both dollars and bitcoin within familiar financial products, the Company aims to give consumers a single, practical platform for managing their everyday finances.
We expect to continue to innovate and expand in the consumer financial services space over the coming years.
Throughout our existence, Fold has been focused on ensuring the safety and security of our customer assets while also complying with regulatory guidance relevant to our business.
In March 2026, we launched the Fold Credit Card on a limited basis, and we plan to continue to roll out this card to a larger customer base over the coming quarters.
The Company anticipates using the proceeds of the CEF Facility for, without limitation, working capital and general corporate purposes.
We intend to continue to build on this success by expanding our existing offerings to further engage our existing users, and we expect to introduce new products to attract new customers.
Here is how we intend to continue our momentum:

We expect these products to continue to expand to more users and to collectively drive higher volumes, revenues, and margins, and we also expect them to both drive new user acquisition and contribute to deeper engagement within the Fold ecosystem.
Over the course of the next few quarters we will continue to explore opportunities to add new consumer financial services that complement and enhance our current offerings.

The timing, execution, and effectiveness of our product and feature releases will impact our ability to meet financial targets for 2026 and beyond; however, we expect that each of these releases will further enhance our existing market position and drive increased volumes across the platform.

In addition to our product strategy, we intend to grow our customer base, transaction volumes, and revenues through increased investment into organic and paid marketing channels that have proven successful to-date.
Fold intends to continue to leverage our social media channels and customer referral program to drive growth via organic channels which have been our primary growth channels to date.

While we expect our existing products to benefit from this growth strategy, we also expect new products to create synergies across product lines and attract new users who are looking for a more comprehensive suite of financial products.

Until such time that we consider it appropriate to utilize our bitcoin in one of those ways, we intend to hold bitcoin as a near- to long-term investment to preserve potential upside in the value of that bitcoin.
This is a reflection of a stable employee headcount over this comparable period, and we do not expect to materially increase headcount in the near term.
Our headcount has remained mostly flat throughout 2026 and we do not expect to materially increase headcount in the near term.
This matter is not expected to recur, and we believe its exclusion provides a more comparable basis for assessing our core operating performance.
The Company anticipates being able to cover the costs for future rewards via future revenues and operational capital on hand.

Although management believes that such capital sources will continue to be available, there can be no assurances that financing will be available to the Company when needed, or if available, on terms acceptable to the Company.

Management expects that the Company’s existing cash and cash equivalents, accounts receivable and credit card receivables, digital assets on hand, and financing available from the Credit Facility and the CEF Facility through the date of filing, will be sufficient to enable the Company to fund its anticipated level of operations through one year from the date of this report.

While the outcome of any future matter is inherently uncertain, we do not currently expect that any such matters, if they were to arise, would have a material adverse effect on our condensed financial position, liquidity, capital resources, or annual results of operations.
We base our estimates on historical experience, anticipated future trends, and other assumptions we believe to be reasonable under the circumstances.

estimates.t: Our discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations are based upon our financial statements, which have been prepared in accordance with GAAP.
